plan_summary: Verify nginx installation status on a Linux host through multiple validation methods and document findings.
assumptions: The target system is a standard Linux distribution
Standard user permissions exist for verification

tasks.title: Identify package manager type on the host
tasks.objective: Determine which Linux package management system is in use (apt, yum, dnf, pacman, etc.)
tasks.rationale: Different distributions use different package managers; knowing this enables correct installation verification commands
tasks.expected_output: Package manager identification result (e.g., apt for Debian/Ubuntu, yum/dnf for RHEL/CentOS)
tasks.success_criteria: Output clearly identifies the active package manager type

tasks.title: Check nginx package installation status via package manager
tasks.objective: Query the package manager to verify if nginx is installed on the system
tasks.rationale: Package manager queries provide authoritative confirmation of installed software packages
tasks.expected_output: Installation status (installed/not installed) with package version information
tasks.success_criteria: Returns definitive yes/no on nginx installation status

tasks.title: Verify nginx binary executable exists in system PATH
tasks.objective: Confirm the nginx binary file is present and accessible at standard locations
tasks.rationale: Binary existence provides secondary verification independent of package manager records
tasks.expected_output: Path to nginx binary or confirmation it does not exist
tasks.success_criteria: Binary path returned or explicit non-existence confirmed

tasks.title: Check nginx service status if systemd is available
tasks.objective: Verify nginx service state (running/stopped/failed) using systemctl
tasks.rationale: Service status provides operational context beyond mere installation presence
tasks.expected_output: Current service state and any error messages if applicable
tasks.success_criteria: Service status clearly reported or systemd unavailable noted

tasks.title: Compile verification findings into summary report
tasks.objective: Document all verification results in a consolidated format
tasks.rationale: Structured output enables downstream processes to consume verification data consistently
tasks.expected_output: Summary report containing installation status, binary path, and service state
tasks.success_criteria: Report contains all verification findings with clear pass/fail conclusion
